nodes.description: _consensusAddress: address whose ECDSA signature is trusted for withdrawal proofs; changing it grants full withdrawal authority.
_usedProofs: mapping marking consumed proof hashes; write-before-effect replay protection in _withdraw.
_bridgeAddressByChainId: whitelist of allowed remote bridge contracts per chain id.
_tokenImplementation: implementation address behind SimpleTokenProxy beacon.
_bondImplementation: implementation address behind InternetBondProxy beacon.
_peggedTokenOrigin: maps pegged token to its origin token and identifies pegged tokens.
_internetBondRatioFeed: external ratio oracle consumed for bond share conversion.
_bridgeRouter: delegatecall target performing token/bond factory deployments.
_nativeTokenMetadata: metadata of the native chain token used as origin marker.
owner: SimpleToken ownership slot, gate for onlyOwner mint/burn.
_balances: internal share balances of SimpleToken/InternetBond.
_totalSupply: internal share supply mutated by mint/burn.
ratioFeed: contract providing the bond conversion ratio.
_rebasing: toggles rebasing share-to-bond conversion logic.
_isOperator: operator whitelist for ratio updates.
_ratios: stored per-token ratios, attacker-influenced via operator path.
initialize: upgradeable entrypoint wiring consensus, factories, feed and router.
withdraw: parses receipt, verifies consensus signature and triggers fund release.
_withdraw: dispatch of native/pegged/erc20 withdrawal paths.
_withdrawNative: low-level native transfer to state.toAddress.
_withdrawPegged: deploys or reuses pegged token and mints tokens to recipient.
_withdrawErc20: rescales amount and transfers underlying ERC20 to recipient.
deposit(toChain,toAddress) payable: locks native currency and emits DepositLocked.
deposit(fromToken,toChain,toAddress,amount): routes to pegged or erc20 deposit path.
_depositPegged: checks balance and burns pegged/bond shares.
_depositErc20: pulls ERC20 via transferFrom and emits DepositLocked.
_factoryPeggedToken: delegatecalls the router to deploy a pegged token and records origin.
_factoryPeggedBond: delegatecalls the router to deploy a pegged bond and records origin.
changeConsensus: owner-only update of the trusted consensus signer.
changeRouter: owner-only replacement of the delegatecall router.
setTokenFactory: owner-only update of the token implementation address.
setBondFactory: owner-only update of the bond implementation address.
addAllowedContract: owner-only whitelisting of remote bridge contract per chain.
updateRatioBatch: operator-only bulk write of oracle ratios.
addOperator: owner-only grant of ratio feed operator role.
SimpleToken.initAndObtainOwnership: takes ownership of an uninitialized template instance.
InternetBond.initAndObtainOwnership: sets ownership, ratio feed and rebasing flag.
SimpleTokenProxy.fallback: beacon lookup and delegatecall forwarding.
SimpleTokenProxy.setBeacon: writes the beacon slot, protected only by a zero-check.
InternetBondProxy.fallback: beacon lookup and delegatecall forwarding.
InternetBondProxy.setBeacon: writes the beacon slot, protected only by a zero-check.
SimpleToken.mint: onlyOwner supply increase for pegged tokens.
InternetBond.mint: onlyOwner share minting accepting amounts in shares.
BridgeRouter.factoryPeggedToken: deploys proxy via CREATE2 and asserts the address matches.
BridgeRouter.factoryPeggedBond: deploys bond proxy via CREATE2 and asserts the address matches.
ECDSAUpgradeable.recover: signature recovery used to authenticate proofs.
Utils.multiplyAndDivideFloor: saturating mul/div helper for share math.
Utils.multiplyAndDivideCeil: ceiling variant of the mul/div helper.
InternetBond._sharesToBonds: converts shares to bonds using the oracle ratio.
InternetBond._bondsToShares: converts bonds to shares using the oracle ratio.
_amountErc20Token: rescales ERC20 amount to 18 decimals after checking decimals<=18.
_amountErc20Bond: computes bond shares with ratio and decimals rescaling.
msg.sender: external caller controlling deposits, ownership grabs and admin gates.
Native value transfer to state.toAddress: forwards all gas to an attacker-chosen recipient.
delegatecall into _bridgeRouter for token factory: executes external code in bridge storage context.
delegatecall into _bridgeRouter for bond factory: executes external code in bridge storage context.
ecrecover precompile call; malleability handled by s/v range checks.
Raw sstore of the beacon slot in SimpleTokenProxy without an owner check.
Raw sstore of the beacon slot in InternetBondProxy without an owner check.
delegatecall to the implementation resolved from the beacon slot in SimpleTokenProxy.fallback.
delegatecall to the implementation resolved from the beacon slot in InternetBondProxy.fallback.
CREATE2 deployment of SimpleTokenProxy then low-level call of setBeacon/init metadata.
CREATE2 deployment of InternetBondProxy then low-level call of setBeacon/init metadata.
unchecked allowance subtraction in ERC20 transferFrom/decreaseAllowance relying on a prior require.
External IERC20.transfer to state.toAddress inside _withdrawErc20.
IERC20Mintable.mint on the pegged token inside _withdrawPegged.
toAddress: destination of withdrawn/credited funds, fully caller supplied.
totalAmount: amount requested for deposit or credited on withdrawal.
fromToken: token address supplied by the depositor.
amount: user supplied token amount for deposit.
proofSignature: consensus signature bytes validated during withdraw.
rawReceipt: RLP receipt bytes hashed and parsed during withdraw.
addresses: token list for batch ratio update.
ratios: ratio values written by the operator.
allowedContract: remote bridge address whitelisted by the owner.
operator: account granted the ratio feed operator role.
fromAddress: caller derived from msg.sender used as source of funds.
toBridge: destination bridge address resolved from the chain id mapping.
toToken: computed pegged/bond token address used for mint or transfer.
hash: keccak256 of the parsed proof structure, signed by the consensus.
state: EthereumVerifier.State decoded from the cross-chain receipt.
proof: ProofParser.Proof structure built from calldata.
scaledAmount: amount rescaled by decimals and ratio before erc20 transfer.
balanceBefore: recipient balance snapshot before the withdrawal transfer.
balanceAfter: recipient balance snapshot after the withdrawal transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes fromAddress in the native deposit event.
msg.sender selects the caller path of the ERC20 deposit entrypoint.
msg.sender is the account whose pegged balance is checked and burned.
withdraw is an external entrypoint reachable by any msg.sender.
addOperator relies on onlyOwner which compares owner() to msg.sender.
updateRatioBatch authorises via msg.sender against owner and operator whitelist.
initAndObtainOwnership assigns owner = msg.sender, so first caller takes the template.
setBeacon is external with only a zero-check, so any msg.sender can set the beacon once.
InternetBondProxy.setBeacon is external with only a zero-check on the beacon slot.
SimpleToken.mint gates on msg.sender == owner.
pegged origin nonzero routes the deposit to _depositPegged.
non-pegged origin routes the deposit to _depositErc20.
withdraw delegates the fund release to the internal _withdraw dispatcher.
native token metadata match routes to _withdrawNative.
pegged peg-in type routes to _withdrawPegged.
unrecognised origin token routes to _withdrawErc20.
withdraw computes the proof hash that guards the _usedProofs replay mapping.
_withdraw checks and writes _usedProofs before releasing funds.
withdraw authenticates the proof exclusively through ECDSA recovery.
recovered signer is compared to _consensusAddress, the single trusted authority.
recover reaches the raw ecrecover precompile after malleability checks.
_withdrawNative forwards state.totalAmount to the attacker chosen state.toAddress.
native transfer hands control to the recipient, allowing re-entry into the withdrawal path if the guard is bypassed.
_withdrawErc20 performs the external token transfer to the recipient.
_withdrawPegged mints the pegged token amount to the recipient.
non-bond metadata routes pegged withdrawal to token factory creation.
bond metadata routes pegged withdrawal to bond factory creation.
_factoryPeggedToken delegatecalls the router with user-influenced metadata.
_factoryPeggedBond delegatecalls the router with user-influenced metadata.
delegatecall executes BridgeRouter.factoryPeggedToken in the bridge storage context.
delegatecall executes BridgeRouter.factoryPeggedBond in the bridge storage context.
router factory performs the CREATE2 proxy deployment and follow-up low-level calls.
router bond factory performs the CREATE2 bond proxy deployment and low-level calls.
proxy fallback resolves the beacon slot and delegatecalls the implementation.
bond proxy fallback resolves the beacon slot and delegatecalls the implementation.
setBeacon writes the beacon slot with a raw sstore guarded only by a null check.
InternetBondProxy.setBeacon writes the beacon slot with a raw sstore.
initialize stores the consensus address that later authorises withdrawals.
changeConsensus rewrites the trusted signer address.
changeRouter repoints the delegatecall target used by both factories.
setTokenFactory rewrites the token implementation used by proxy delegatecalls.
setBondFactory rewrites the bond implementation used by proxy delegatecalls.
addAllowedContract writes the remote bridge whitelist checked in withdraw.
addOperator grants whitelist membership consumed by onlyOperator.
updateRatioBatch gates on _isOperator for msg.sender.
updateRatioBatch writes oracle ratios that drive share conversion.
pegged deposit converts bond amounts to shares with multiplyAndDivideFloor.
rebasing erc20 withdrawal rescales with multiplyAndDivideCeil.
_sharesToBonds reads the ratio from the external ratio feed.
_bondsToShares reads the ratio from the external ratio feed.
InternetBond.mint reports the minted value in bonds via _sharesToBonds.
_rebasing selects whether the ratio conversion is applied at all.
initAndObtainOwnership assigns the owner slot that guards mint/burn.
bond initializer sets the ratio feed address and rebasing flag.
toAddress parameter is copied into the DepositLocked event for the native path.
toAddress parameter directs the credited recipient in the ERC20 deposit path.
totalAmount parameter flows into the pegged/erc20 deposit branches.
state.totalAmount is the amount forwarded by the native withdrawal.
fromToken parameter selects the deposit branch and origin lookup.
fromToken is burned from the caller inside _depositPegged.
amount parameter is the transferred token quantity for deposits.
proofSignature is fed directly to the consensus signature check.
rawReceipt is hashed to bind the receipt preimage to the proof.
addresses array indexes the ratio storage writes.
ratios array values are stored per address without bound checks.
allowedContract parameter is written into the bridge whitelist.
operator parameter is granted the operator flag.
fromAddress local derives from msg.sender for the native lock event.
fromAddress local is the account whose balance is checked and burned.
fromAddress local is the transferFrom source in _depositErc20.
toBridge local comes from the chain id whitelist and can be zero-checked.
toBridge local is used to derive pegged destination addresses.
toToken local is derived from router address computation.
toToken local is the mint target in pegged withdrawal.
hash local is the value verified against the consensus signature.
hash local is the replay-protection key written into _usedProofs.
decoded receipt state drives all withdrawal branch decisions.
parsed proof struct supplies chainId and hash fields for verification.
scaledAmount local is the value passed to the external token transfer.
balanceBefore snapshot is compared after the external transfer.
balanceAfter snapshot enforces the post-transfer balance invariant.

normalization_plan.reason: toAddress is a caller supplied deposit parameter; fold it into the deposit entrypoint it parameterises.
totalAmount only parameterises deposit amount handling; fold into the deposit function.
fromToken is the deposit token selector; fold into the deposit function.
amount is the deposit token quantity; fold into the deposit function.
proofSignature is consumed only by the withdraw signature check.
rawReceipt is consumed only by the withdraw receipt hashing.
addresses is consumed only by the batch ratio update loop.
ratios is consumed only by the batch ratio update loop.
allowedContract is written only by addAllowedContract.
operator is written only by addOperator.
fromAddress is a transient alias of msg.sender inside the deposit paths.
toBridge is a transient lookup derived from the chain id mapping.
toToken is a transient derived address only meaningful to the withdrawal routing.
hash is the transient proof digest used solely for signature verification.
decoded receipt state only drives the internal _withdraw dispatcher.
parsed proof struct exists only within the withdraw verification flow.
scaledAmount is a transient rescaling result used only in _withdrawErc20.
balanceBefore is a transient snapshot used only for the transfer invariant.
balanceAfter is a transient snapshot used only for the transfer invariant.
